title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. A women get divorce, she has two male kids with age of 4 and 1.5 years. now mother want that kids should stay with her and father want the same. What Quran and Hadith says about this problem and where kids should go? 1664 views Q. Respected Scholar: We sent some of our kids to a so called darul uloom here in USA upon my spouse wish in spite of the fact that darul uloom was 6 hours flight from our city and my view was that sending them that far we will not be able to see them very often specially the girls plus it will be very expensive as we are a medium class family. We have spent all our financial resources on them even if we have to cut some times on our budget.... 2272 views Q. Want to study in Madrasa 3220 views Q. I have heard that astrophysics cant be studied. What is your view about it? 1810 views Q. assalamualaikum mufti saab. i want to ask you that i have read many hadith from the bukhari sharif. now can i say these to other people (i.e. to use in tableegi bayans). am i allowed to say the hadith or explain it with the references given on bukhari sharif. or do i need any certificate like ( from any moulanas to explain it). please reply me as soon as possible. jazak Allah. 2275 views Q. میرا سوال یہ ہے کہ : (۱) شریعت کے مطابق اسکالر شپ (وظیفہ ) کے پیسے کو کیسے استعمال کیا جائے؟تفصیل سے بتائیں۔ (۲) کیا میں اس رقم سے پڑھائی کے مقصد سے لیپ ٹاپ خرید سکتاہوں؟ (۳) کیا میں اس کو اپنے ذاتی استعمال جیسے کپڑے/جوتے وغیرہ خریدنے میں خرچ کرسکتاہوں؟ 1649 views Q. Is it permissible for girls and boys to study together? 3527 views Q. Asalamualaikum wa rahmatullahe wabaratuh 1- Over here in some Schools Religious education is compulsory for Muslims, so the teachers take the children to see Masjids,Church,Mandir,Temple etc my question is that is it permissible for the children to go inside the Church,Mandir,Temple etc? 2-Is there any sahih hadith which forbids Muslims from going inside a Church,Mandir etc to have a look? 3-Is it haram and a Sin to go inside a Church,Mandir etc to have a look? 2556 views Q. I am a university student doing B.S in biotechnology.A few days back my mind for continuing my studies sort of changed;i felt a strong urge of quitting my studies and going for an aalma course but the thing is that my mother(to whom i havn't told my recent plan)is very serious about my uni education and she even cried a bit about how much dreams she has associated with me.At this point i am really really confused as to what to do because i don't want to hurt her and i don't want to let my aalma dreams go to waste as well. Please do reply. 2000 views Q. Can you please recommend me a book on Ahkam of Masjid in Urdu 1711 views Q. I am studying in eng. college in B.Tech course.I have applied for education loan in minority commision.LOAN IS GRANTED BY THE STATE GOVERNMENT @3% interest. is it halal for me as my parents are unable to pay a huge amount of fees.please clear my confusion. 2901 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 8361 Country: Canada Title: I am interested in trying to create a habit of conforming to the Sunnah of Prophet Muhammad (SAW). What kitab would you recommend I study and refer to for the Sunnah method of normal day-to-day activities? Question: I am interested in trying to create a habit of conforming to the Sunnah of Prophet Muhammad (SAW). What kitab would you recommend I study and refer to for the Sunnah method of normal day-to-day activities? Answer ID: 8361 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1278/1093=L/1429) You should study Rasoolullah ki Sunnatain (Maulana Hakim Muhammad Akhtar), Khasail Nabvi (Shaikhul Hadith Maulana Zakaria) and Shamail Kubra (Mufti Muhammad Irshad). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
